item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas mchog lnga'i rtsa gsum yang snying 'dus pa'i las byang bsam 'phel nor bu
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spangs kyi nang nas mchog lnga rtsa gsum yang snying las byang bsam 'phel nor bu 'di yang bon sgo gzhan du rigs 'dres phyir du/ gter gzhung nas dgos bde'i phyir du/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'breng / tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des/ shar grol smin gling du bsgrigs nas spel ba'o//
